finding_core_basis.text: FOUNDATION MAIN_CORE = GF FFL +1.00 minus a footing underside AT -1.50 (2.50 - H); T-206 r2 (MERGED) prints footing bottom = formation + 0.17 (5 screed + 2 membrane + 10 blinding) with the formation 'not less than 1.5 m below the existing plot level' (Q-21 C, a minimum, existing-ground datum HELD). The ledger's 2.50 - H therefore implies a formation at -1.67; with the formation at its printed limit relative to +-0.00 the core is 0.17 m SHORTER, so the 'LOWER_BOUND' label of the foundation cores is not a lower bound of the printed geometry: a labelled convention (no ledger edit here; the lap zones are unaffected because the core still starts at the footing top).
